BrochureContent.Content:
31 Stephen Street is presented to the market by Bowe Property as a most unusual offering in terms of a newly rebuilt and constructed home within one of Cork’s most attractive and oldest residential enclaves of the south side of Cork city.  No. 31 sits at the upper end of Stephens Street within a regimental and eclectic mix of wonderful town houses and a solid community. Upon entering the property you are immediately greeted by a house of superb design, exceptional finishes and modern 21st century A-rated comforts with premium Nilan heating system throughout, A-rated windows, high levels of insulation and luxurious fittings incorporating a hand-crafted kitchen with premium appliances, premium bathrooms incorporating both a guest w.c., family bathroom and master bedroom en-suite. An open-plan kitchen/dining/living area with near floor to ceiling gliding glazed doors to wonderful enclosed patio gardens with sublime city views of iconic Church spires, residential roof-tops and other landmark Cork buildings. 
Accommodation extends to 121sq.m. and the property has a stylish appointment with herringbone flooring, ceramic tiling, luxurious carpets, premium bathroom sanitary ware, large A-rated effective glazing taking advantage of the properties both setting and outlook, as well as premium kitchens and a premium Nilan heating system creating a warm and efficient environment both to live and run in terms of experience and costs. Within walking distance of all of Cork city and within a community that is solid and reputable No. 31 is a house of 21st century, high-rated standards in a old, historic and charming part of Cork city suburbs.
